lines.en: label sarabar25p2:
scene sarawindow1
I follow Sara over to the window and get my first ever look at the view from her...apartment or...condo or...you know what? I’m not really sure what to call it here.
lines.zh: 我跟着 Sara 走到窗边，有生以来第一次看清她那……公寓？还是……公寓式住宅？算了，我真不知道这儿该怎么叫。

lines.en: The place she falls asleep at night.
lines.zh: 她夜里入睡的地方。

lines.en: Except for on the nights she doesn’t.
lines.zh: 除了她不在这儿睡的那些夜晚。

lines.en: Believe it or not, I don’t have any idea what it’s like to be a single mother, so I’m not really sure how much something like that weighs on her ability to close her eyes.
lines.zh: 信不信由你，我完全不懂做一个单亲母亲是什么滋味，所以也说不好那种事对她合上双眼这件事到底有多重。

lines.en: I watch as her breath makes contact with the glass, fogging it up and forcing me into a rare memory of windows from when I was younger.
lines.zh: 我看着她的呼吸碰上玻璃，蒙起一层雾，把我硬生生推回一段久违的、关于儿时窗户的记忆里。

lines.en: Just, in my mind, there’s no reflection staring back at me.
lines.zh: 只是，在我脑海里，没有倒影在回望我。

lines.en: No array of city lights injecting their glow into my eyes through a reinforced, transparent pane serving as the one and only barrier between me and the puddle I’d be if I were to just fall through it.
lines.zh: 没有那一整片城市的灯火，透过那层加固的透明玻璃把光灌进我的眼睛——那块玻璃是我和「如果我掉下去就会变成的那滩东西」之间唯一的屏障。

lines.en: I wonder if the fall would kill us from here.
lines.zh: 我在想，从这个高度摔下去会不会摔死。

lines.en: Probably not, now that I think about it.
lines.zh: 现在想想，大概不会。

lines.en: This is only the second story. We’d have to land perfectly in order for that drop to end our lives.
lines.zh: 这里才二楼。我们得落得分毫不差，这一跳才可能要了我们的命。

lines.en: I’m not sure why I’m thinking about this now, though.
lines.zh: 不过我不明白自己为什么现在会想这些。

lines.en: Nor do I have any idea of why seeing her like this would make me {i}almost{/i} remember something from the past when I assumed it to be all but abandoned.
lines.zh: 我同样不明白，为什么看到她这副样子，会让我{i}几乎{/i}想起一件我早以为彻底丢掉的往事。

lines.en: : Do you notice anything different about me, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你有没有发现我哪里不一样了？

lines.en: : Different?
lines.zh: : 不一样？

lines.en: : You don’t, do you?
lines.zh: : 你没发现，对吧？

lines.en: : Uhh...
: I let my hair down.
lines.zh: : 我把头发放下来了。

lines.en: : It was up just a minute ago.
lines.zh: : 刚才还扎着呢。

lines.en: : Do you know what that means?
lines.zh: : 你知道那意味着什么吗？

lines.en: : ...Not really, no.
lines.zh: : ……不太知道。

lines.en: : It means I’m more comfortable now.
lines.zh: : 意味着我现在更自在了。

lines.en: : I had no idea you were so intimidated by your pint-sized daughter that it was actively affecting your comfort level.
lines.zh: : 我还不知道你被自己那个小不点女儿吓成这样，都实实在在影响到你的舒适度了。

lines.en: scene sarawindow2
: That’s obviously not what I meant. Of course I’m comfortable with Sana.
lines.zh: : 我显然不是那个意思。我对 Sana 当然很自在。

lines.en: : I just mean that I’ve officially moved into “relax” mode...and that you being here and towering over me like that isn’t putting me on edge.
lines.zh: : 我只是说，我正式切换到「放松模式」了……而且你这样站在这儿、居高临下地俯视我，也没让我觉得紧张。

lines.en: : I didn’t really expect it would. Based on past experiences, you might actually even be a little {i}too{/i} comfortable around me.
lines.zh: : 我本来也没指望你会紧张。根据以往的经验，你在我身边说不定还自在了点{i}过头{/i}。

lines.en: scene sarawindow3
: Is there such a thing as that?
lines.zh: : 还有这种说法吗？

lines.en: : Yes. Yes, there is.
lines.zh: : 有。确实有。

lines.en: : This feels nice, you know.
lines.zh: : 这样挺好的，你知道吗。

lines.en: : Not just standing here, looking out at the street like this...I’m talking about the entire night.
lines.zh: : 不只是像这样站着、看着外面的街道……我是说整个晚上。

lines.en: : Is this the part where you start trying to add me into your family again?
lines.zh: : 这是不是就到了你又开始试图把我拉进你们家那一步了？

lines.en: if sarasex == False:
: It’s not.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: : You’ve already made it clear that you have no intention of ever looking at me that way.
lines.zh: : 你已经说得很清楚了，你根本没打算用那种眼光看我。

lines.en: : But I can still feel happy right now even if we’re just friends, can’t I?
lines.zh: : 可就算我们只是朋友，我现在也还是可以觉得幸福吧？

lines.en: : You can feel however you want to feel. It’s just not going to change how {i}I{/i} feel.
lines.zh: : 你想怎么感觉都行。只是那改变不了{i}我{/i}的感觉。

lines.en: : Then, as a friend, can I ask you a question?
lines.zh: : 那么，作为朋友，我能问你一个问题吗？

lines.en: : A real question. Not one about the two of us or...even helping out with the bar.
lines.zh: : 一个正经问题。不是关于我们俩的，也不是……关于帮酒吧忙的。

lines.en: : I just want to know how you feel about something.
lines.zh: : 我只是想知道你对某件事怎么看。

lines.en: : Then...by all means.
lines.zh: : 那么……请说。

lines.en: else:

lines.zh: : 不会……

lines.en: : Yes...
lines.zh: : 也许会……

lines.en: : Maybe?
lines.zh: : 也许？

lines.en: : I know you’re not looking for a real relationship right now, but I’d be lying if I told you it didn’t feel like the two of us were actually dating sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我知道你现在并不想认真谈一场恋爱，但如果我说我从不觉得我们俩其实在约会，那就是在撒谎。

lines.en: : You really don’t think this would be nice? Ending every night with this view?
lines.zh: : 你真不觉得这样很好吗？每天晚上都以这片景色收尾？

lines.en: : Hovering close enough behind me that you could pull me in and make me yours at a moment’s notice?
lines.zh: : 贴得离我这么近，近到你随时都能把我拽过去，让我变成你的？

lines.en: : I mean, I’m pretty sure I could do that right now and you wouldn’t object in the slightest.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我很确定我现在就能那么做，而且你一点都不会反对。

lines.en: : Tonight, I think I would, actually.
lines.zh: : 今晚的话，我想我会反对的。

lines.en: : Oh?
: Yeah...
: You see, there’s something that’s been on my mind for a little while now, and it’s something I couldn’t really just come out and ask in front of Sana.
lines.zh: : 是这样，有件事在我心里搁了一阵子了，是那种在 Sana 面前实在开不了口问的。

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思？

lines.en: scene sarawindow4
: Do you think deciding to raise Sana on my own was the best thing to do after her father left?
lines.zh: : 你觉得，她父亲走后，我决定一个人把 Sana 拉扯大，是最好的选择吗？

lines.en: : Or would it have been better to just find some other guy and pull him into the picture? Not out of love or anything, but out of...obligation? Is that the word I’m looking for?
lines.zh: : 还是说，随便找个别男人把他拉进这幅画面里会更好？不是因为爱什么的，而是出于……责任？我要找的是这个词吗？

lines.en: : That’s a pretty heavy question to just drop on me out of nowhere, Sara.
lines.zh: : Sara，你这么没头没脑地就把这么沉重的问题砸给我。

lines.en: : If you think that’s heavy, you’d be an even worse mother than I am.
lines.zh: : 如果你觉得这算沉重，那你当母亲会比我还要糟。

lines.en: scene sarawindow5
: I knew it was going to be hard, you know. After he left.
lines.zh: : 我知道那会很艰难，你知道的。他走了之后。

lines.en: : But when you’re on your own and have to look after someone else, you need to carry so much weight that it feels like your arms are just going to...break off sometimes.
lines.zh: : 可是当你孤身一人、还得照顾另一个人的时候，你得扛的东西太重了，重到有时候觉得自己的胳膊就要……断掉。

lines.en: : I am well aware of how horrible a mother I would be, but I don’t really think it’s my place to tell you whether or not you should have just roped some unsuspecting guy in to help you.
lines.zh: : 我很清楚自己当母亲会有多糟糕，但我真觉得还轮不到我来告诉你，当初是不是该随便拉个倒霉男人来帮你。

lines.en: : Especially not after directly proving how bad you are at choosing men.
lines.zh: : 尤其是在你刚刚亲口证明了你挑男人的眼光有多差之后。

lines.en: scene sarawindow6
: It’s not like I just asked Sana's dad to be with me one day, you know? He had just as much to do with it as I did.
lines.zh: : 我又不是某天突然就求 Sana 她爸跟我在一起的，你知道吧？这事儿他出的力不比我少。

lines.en: : I didn't just wake up one morning and think, “I want to have a baby with my teacher.”
lines.zh: : 我也不是某天早上醒来就想，「我要和老师生个孩子」。

lines.en: : Based on personal experience, I’m not sure how honest that statement is.
lines.zh: : 根据个人经验，我不太确定这句话有多诚实。

lines.en: : I feel like there are several girls in my class that think that first thing every morning.
lines.zh: : 我感觉我们班上有好几个女生每天早上起来第一件事就是这么想的。

lines.en: scene sarawindow7
: And how many of them are you sleeping with?
lines.zh: : 那你和她们中的几个上过床？

lines.en: : I hope that’s just a rhetorical question and that you’re not accusing me of anything right now.
lines.zh: : 我希望这只是个反问句，而不是你此刻在指控我什么。

lines.en: : Well, based on {i}my{/i} personal experience, every high school teacher I’ve ever had has fucked me. So it’s not like it would be the most shocking revelation in the world.
lines.zh: : 嗯，根据{i}我的{/i}个人经验，我遇到的每一个高中老师都操过我。所以就算真有这种事，也不算世上最惊人的爆料。

lines.en: : {i}Every{/i} teacher?
lines.zh: : {i}每一个{/i}老师？

lines.en: : Mhm. I mean, I only had one, but that’s still a 100%% success rate. Or failure rate, depending on how you look at it.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。我是说，我只有一个老师，但那也算是 100%% 的成功率。或者失败率，看你怎么看。

lines.en: : Ahh. So it’s not just our high school that enforces that “One teacher for everything” policy.
lines.zh: : 啊。所以不止我们高中在推行「一个老师包揽全部」的政策。

lines.en: : Isn’t your high school the only one that’s left in Kumon-mi now?
lines.zh: : 现在 Kumon-mi 不是只剩你们那所高中了吗？

lines.en: : The other one still exists. It’s just at the bottom of a hole somewhere.
lines.zh: : 另一所还在。只是在某个洞底下。

lines.en: : Aren’t we all?
lines.zh: : 我们不都在洞底下吗？

lines.en: : Well, that’s a lot more negative of a statement than I’m used to from you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这话可比我平时听你说的消极多了。

lines.en: scene sarawindow8
: You know, I feel like for most mothers, there are a lot of memories that they look back on and smile.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我觉得对大多数母亲来说，有很多回忆是她们回头看时会笑的。

lines.en: : But for me, it’s like every single memory I look back on is either filled with tragedy or just...me making some sort of mistake.
lines.zh: : 但对我来说，我回望的每一段记忆，要么塞满了悲剧，要么就只是……我又犯了什么错。

lines.en: : I tried really hard, too.
lines.zh: : 我也很努力了。

lines.en: : I really did.
lines.zh: : 真的努力了。

lines.en: : And I’m still trying now. But it’s like every single day, I have to figure out how to tie a new knot around Sana so she doesn’t drift off and leave me completely and utterly alone.
lines.zh: : 现在也还在努力。可就像每一天，我都得想办法在 Sana 身上再系一个新的结，好让她不会漂走，把我一个人孤零零地丢下。

lines.en: : I doubt she’s-
lines.zh: : 我怀疑她不会——

lines.en: : People leave me, Sensei. It’s what they do.
lines.zh: : 人们会离开我，Sensei。他们就是会。

lines.en: : Sometimes it’s purposely, sometimes it’s not. But it happens.
lines.zh: : 有时候是故意的，有时候不是。但总会发生。

lines.en: : I thought Sana’s father was different. I thought he was going to be there forever.
lines.zh: : 我原以为 Sana 的父亲不一样。我以为他会永远在。

lines.en: : I thought all of those things he promised weren’t just empty words, but reflections of his heart even clearer than ours in this glass.
lines.zh: : 我以为他许下的那些诺言不是空话，而是比我们映在这玻璃上的倒影还要清晰的心意。

lines.en: : But I guess having just one teenage girl to sleep with isn’t enough for some people.
lines.zh: : 但我想，对有些人来说，只睡一个十几岁的女孩是不够的。

lines.en: : It’s like...
lines.zh: : 就像……

lines.en: : It’s like all men start out great, but the second a kid comes into the picture, the worst parts of them come out and replace all of the good ones.
lines.zh: : 就像所有男人一开始都很好，可一旦孩子进入画面，他们最糟糕的部分就会冒出来，把好的那些全替换掉。

lines.en: : I’m sure that happens the other way around, too, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我相信反过来也一样。

lines.en: : I’m sure there are just as many mothers who can’t handle parenthood as there are fathers.
lines.zh: : 我相信受不了为人父母的母亲，和父亲一样多。

lines.en: : Are you talking about me?
lines.zh: : 你是在说我吗？

lines.en: scene sarawindow9
: No. All things considered, I think you did fine. Sana might be quiet and awkward, but she’s a good person. And you should be at least somewhat proud of yourself for that.
lines.zh: : 不是。总的来看，我觉得你做得不错。Sana 也许是安静又别扭，但她是个好孩子。至少你应该为自己这一点感到些许骄傲。

lines.en: : {i}Fine{/i} isn’t good enough for a childhood.
lines.zh: : {i}「不错」{/i}对一个童年来说不够。

lines.en: : It could have been {i}better{/i}. Things could have been better.
lines.zh: : 本可以{i}更好{/i}的。一切本可以更好的。

lines.en: : She could have had such an amazing life if I had just been a little smarter when I was her age and waited for someone to {i}actually{/i} love me rather than just...pretend to.
lines.zh: : 如果我在她这个年纪聪明一点，等一个{i}真正{/i}爱我的人，而不是……只是装作爱我的人，她本可以拥有多么美好的人生。

lines.en: : Maybe. But she’s only Sana because she exists now. If you had waited any longer, you could have wound up with a completely different kid.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。但她之所以是 Sana，只是因为她现在存在。要是你再等下去，你可能会得到一个完全不同的孩子。

lines.en: scene sarawindow10
: A...different...
lines.zh: : 一个……不同的……

lines.en: : Umm...anyway...I just...
lines.zh: : 嗯……总之……我只是……

lines.en: : I don’t...really know.
lines.zh: : 我……不太清楚。

lines.en: : I didn’t have much of a childhood.
lines.zh: : 我没怎么拥有过童年。

lines.en: : So when it came time to raise...children of my own, I just did whatever I wished would have been done for me when I was their age.
lines.zh: : 所以轮到我自己……养孩子的时候，我就只是做了我在那个年纪希望别人对我做的事。

lines.en: : You know that thing that some parents do with their kids when they’re trying to teach them to swim? Like...how they just toss them into the water and let them figure it out on their own?
lines.zh: : 你知道有些父母教孩子游泳时会怎么做吗？就是……直接把他们扔进水里，让他们自己琢磨？

lines.en: : Wait, did you actually do that?
lines.zh: : 等等，你真那么做了？

lines.en: : Oh, no. I’m just using that as a metaphor.
lines.zh: : 哦，没有。我只是拿它打个比方。

lines.en: scene sarawindow11
: I was able to figure out how to swim eventually...and I was able to climb out of the pool...but it was only just barely.
lines.zh: : 我最后总算学会了怎么游……也总算爬出了泳池……但也只是勉强而已。

lines.en: : And all the while, instead of anyone trying to help, it’s like they were watching me struggling for my life and either laughing or just walking away.
lines.zh: : 而在那整个过程中，没有任何人想帮忙，他们就像是在看着我拼命挣扎，要么大笑，要么直接走开。

lines.en: : If I had someone...{i}anyone{/i} to lean on back then...I can only imagine how much happier Sana would be now.
lines.zh: : 如果那时候我有个人……{i}任何人{/i}可以依靠……我简直不敢想象 Sana 现在会有多幸福。

lines.en: : And...
lines.zh: : 还有……

lines.en: scene sarawindow12
: And...
lines.zh: : 还有……

lines.en: scene sarawindow13
: And what, Sara?
lines.zh: : 还有什么，Sara？

lines.en: : What were {i}your{/i} parents like, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，{i}你{/i}父母是什么样的人？

lines.en: : Mine? I don’t really remember.
lines.zh: : 我的？我不太记得了。

lines.en: : Why do you ask?
lines.zh: : 为什么问这个？

lines.en: : Because you turned out to be a decent person.
lines.zh: : 因为你长成了一个还算不错的人。

lines.en: : And I guess I’m kind of wishfully thinking, in the nicest way possible, that your parents weren't all that great...
lines.zh: : 而我大概是在以最善意的方式痴心妄想，希望你的父母没那么好……

lines.en: : And that you succeeded at becoming who you are in the face of people who doubted you...
lines.zh: : 希望你是在那些怀疑你的人面前，才成就了现在的自己……

lines.en: : Or ignored you when you needed help the most...
lines.zh: : 或是在你最需要帮助的时候被无视……

lines.en: : Or beat you for speaking out of line...
lines.zh: : 或是说了不该说的话就挨打……

lines.en: : Or beat you for staying out a little past curfew...
lines.zh: : 或是比门禁晚回来一点就挨打……

lines.en: scene sarawindow14
: Or beat you for ever even speaking at all!
lines.zh: : 或者只是开口说话就挨打！

lines.en: : But you were just a little girl!
lines.zh: : 可你那时候还只是个小女孩啊！

lines.en: : And all you wanted was a place to come home to that you weren’t terrified of!
lines.zh: : 你想要的，只是一个回家之后不用害怕的地方！

lines.en: : No wonder I would stay out late!
lines.zh: : 难怪我会在外面待到很晚！

lines.en: : No wonder I needed help!
lines.zh: : 难怪我需要帮助！

lines.en: : It’s because I’ve been all alone since the beginning!
lines.zh: : 因为我从一开始就是孤身一人！

lines.en: : Since before there were any kids involved!
lines.zh: : 早在还没有孩子之前！

lines.en: scene sarawindow15
: And I just...
lines.zh: : 而我只是……

lines.en: : I’ve never known what the {i}right{/i} thing to do is. So even if I {i}do{/i} the right thing, I’ll still wind up questioning myself.
lines.zh: : 我从来不知道什么是{i}对的{/i}。所以就算我{i}做{/i}对了，我还是会质疑自己。

lines.en: : I thought falling for an adult who understood the world would have been enough to help me get at least {i}that{/i} much.
lines.zh: : 我原以为，爱上一个懂这个世界的成年人，至少能帮我弄明白{i}这一点{/i}。

lines.en: : To figure out how to...take care of someone else.
lines.zh: : 学会怎么……照顾另一个人。

lines.en: : So that my children could come home and talk to me without having to wait their turn...
lines.zh: : 这样我的孩子回家就能跟我说话，不用排着队等……

lines.en: : Without having to worry about waking up an extra hour early on weekdays just so they can figure out how much makeup they need to cover black eyes or bruises.
lines.zh: : 不用为了算计要抹多厚的粉才能盖住青肿的眼眶和淤青，而在工作日早起一个小时。

lines.en: : I just wanted to be a good mom...
lines.zh: : 我只是想当个好妈妈……

lines.en: : That’s all I wanted...
lines.zh: : 这就是我全部想要的……

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : It's like the world didn't want me to be one.
lines.zh: : 就好像这个世界不想要我当一个好妈妈。

lines.en: : That’s been the best sales pitch for turning me into an honorary Sakakibara yet.
lines.zh: : 这可是把我说服成荣誉 Sakakibara 家一员的最佳推销词了。

lines.en: scene sarawindow16
: Pfft!
: I’m sorry. I’ve been really emotional lately. And waiting to pour all of that out on you instead of Sana is just one more potential mistake I’m making in the world of parenting.
lines.zh: : 对不起。我最近情绪真的很不稳定。而把这些全都倒给你、而不是倒给 Sana，只是我在育儿这门功课上又犯下的一个潜在错误。

lines.en: : Not as big of a mistake as {i}actually{/i} inviting me into the world of parenting.
lines.zh: : 总没有{i}真的{/i}邀请我踏进育儿世界那么大的错。

lines.en: scene sarawindow17
: Listen, I’m not going to spend the next ten minutes trying to tell you that things are going to get better or that you’re safe now or anything like that-
lines.zh: : 听着，我不打算花接下来的十分钟告诉你一切都会好起来、你现在安全了之类的话——

lines.en: : Frankly, things could get even worse for you any day now.
lines.zh: : 坦白说，你的处境随时都可能变得更糟。

lines.en: : Well, that’s not very reassuring.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这话可真不让人安心。

lines.en: : You’re right, it’s not. Sometimes, horrible things happen to people who don’t deserve them. And you’ve been on the receiving end of that for basically forever.
lines.zh: : 你说得对，是不安心。有时候，可怕的事会发生在不该承受的人身上。而你基本上一直都在承受。

lines.en: : But if it helps in the slightest to hear me say that {i}you don’t deserve it...{/i}
lines.zh: : 但如果听我说一句{i}「你不该承受这些」{/i}能有一丁点用的话……

lines.en: : Well, that’s really all I can do.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那也就是我唯一能做的了。

lines.en: : Any more consolation than that would just be pity, and I’m sure you don’t want any of that.
lines.zh: : 再多安慰就成了怜悯，我猜你也不想要那种东西。

lines.en: : Oh, no. Pity away. This whole crying thing is actually kind of fun when my tears aren’t dripping into my wine glass.
lines.zh: : 哦，不，尽管怜悯吧。当我的眼泪不是滴进酒杯里的时候，哭一哭其实还挺有意思的。

lines.en: : Then I guess it’s kind of good I’m such a horrible employee and didn’t get you a drink after all, huh?
lines.zh: : 那我这个员工当得这么糟糕、到底也没给你拿酒来，还挺好的咯？

lines.en: : Yeah, I guess it is good.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是挺好的。

lines.en: : This does mean that I’m going to have to fire you, though. Because not only will you not listen to your boss, but that obnoxiously handsome face of yours is starting to distract one of my employees.
lines.zh: : 不过这意味着我得开除你了。因为你不光不听老板的话，你那张帅得讨人厌的脸还开始让我的一名员工分心了。

lines.en: : Damn Yuki. Spending all of her time fantasizing about me instead of learning how to mix drinks.
lines.zh: : 该死的 Yuki。把所有时间都花在幻想我上，而不是学怎么调酒。

lines.en: : I’m not talking about Yuki, dummy.
lines.zh: : 我说的不是 Yuki，笨蛋。

lines.en: : I know. But it’s common knowledge that you’re in love with me already and it’s no fun just pointing that out over and over.
lines.zh: : 我知道。但「你早就爱上我了」这事儿是公开的秘密，一遍遍指出来就没意思了。

lines.en: scene sarawindow18
: First off, rude.
lines.zh: : 首先，你太失礼了。

lines.en: scene sarawindow19
: Second, I’m talking about my daughter.
lines.zh: : 其次，我说的是我女儿。

lines.en: : Sana? I’m pretty sure her feelings for me are nothing more than “Please don’t bone my mom.”
lines.zh: : Sana？我很确定她对我的感情不过就是「请别操我妈」而已。

lines.en: : You know she has {i}my{/i} blood, right? There is no way that is the only thing she thinks about you.
lines.zh: : 你知道她身上流着{i}我的{/i}血吧？她对你的想法绝不可能只有那一个。

lines.en: : Don’t cancel out your daughter’s purity just because you were horny for your high school teacher.
lines.zh: : 别因为你当年对高中老师发过情，就把你女儿的纯洁一笔勾销了。

lines.en: : Don’t expect her to be “pure” just because she’s tiny and quiet.
lines.zh: : 也别因为她个子小又安静，就指望她「纯洁」。

lines.en: : Who we are on the outside has absolutely no bearing on the versions of ourselves we keep locked away.
lines.zh: : 我们外在的样子，跟我们锁起来的那个自己毫无关系。

lines.en: : For example, I didn’t {i}look{/i} like a girl who was fucking the teacher. But just a few years later, I was begging him to stay while holding a baby with one hand and a carrot with the other.
lines.zh: : 比如说，我当年{i}看起来{/i}不像是个会跟老师上床的女孩。可才过了几年，我就一手抱着孩子、一手攥着胡萝卜，求他留下来。

lines.en: : In hindsight, the carrot probably made my plea look a little less serious, but the moral of the story is to expect the unexpected.
lines.zh: : 现在想想，那根胡萝卜大概让我的恳求显得没那么严肃，但这故事的寓意是：要料到意料之外。

lines.en: : And also that carrots are the root of all evil.
lines.zh: : 还有就是，胡萝卜是万恶之源。

lines.en: : This conversation took a weird turn.
lines.zh: : 这话题聊得有点歪了。

lines.en: scene sarawindow20
: All I’m saying is to not be surprised if Sana winds up being a little less pure than you expect her to be.
lines.zh: : 我只是说，如果 Sana 最后没你以为的那么纯洁，也别惊讶。

lines.en: : She’s still my daughter, and all she knows is what she’s grown up around. IE: Sex toys and romance novels.
lines.zh: : 她到底是我的女儿，而她所知道的，只有她从小耳濡目染的那些。也就是：性玩具和言情小说。

lines.en: if bar50 == True:
: Also, she asked me about condoms the other day and I’m still trying to figure out what that was all about.
lines.zh: : 另外，她前几天还问我避孕套的事，我到现在还在想那到底是怎么回事。

lines.en: : Wow, really? I have absolutely no idea why that is something she would have brought up to you.
lines.zh: : 哇，真的吗？我完全想不出她为什么会跟你提这个。

lines.en: : Just...
lines.zh: : 只是……

lines.en: : Don’t let her do anything stupid, okay?
lines.zh: : 别让她做傻事，好吗？

lines.en: : Don’t let her be another me.
lines.zh: : 别让她变成第二个我。

lines.en: : I can assure you that having your daughter harbor my children is at the very bottom of my to-do list.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，让你女儿怀上我的孩子这件事，排在我待办清单的最底下。

lines.en: Fucking her, on the other hand, is an entirely different story. But Sara just asked me to prevent her from doing anything “stupid” and I don’t think that’s stupid at all.
lines.zh: 操她那就是另一回事了。但 Sara 刚刚只是求我别让她做「傻事」，而我觉得那一点也不傻。

lines.en: scene sarawindow21
: Are you telling me you’d say no if a girl as cute as my daughter wanted to sleep with you?
lines.zh: : 你是说，如果有个像我女儿那么可爱的女孩想跟你睡，你会拒绝？

lines.en: : My instinct here makes me want to tell you I {i}would{/i} say no...but I also think you might be the type to get insulted if I told you I wouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 我的本能让我想告诉你我{i}会{/i}拒绝……但我也觉得，我要是说我不会，你可能会觉得被冒犯。

lines.en: : You’re right. This {i}could{/i} go both ways, couldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 你说得对。这事儿两头都{i}能{/i}走，是吧？

lines.en: : Can I just elect to not answer?
lines.zh: : 我能不能选择不回答？

lines.en: : What? You’re really not going to clear up that you wouldn’t have sex with my daughter if she asked you to?
lines.zh: : 什么？你真不肯澄清一下，就算你女儿主动，你也不会跟她上床？

lines.en: : Okay, fine. I wouldn’t have sex with your daughter if she asked me to.
lines.zh: : 好吧，行。就算你女儿主动，我也不会跟她上床。

lines.en: : Are you insane? She’s the cutest thing in the world. How dare you?
lines.zh: : 你疯了吗？她是世界上最可爱的东西。你怎么敢？

lines.en: : Wow. There’s really no winning this after all.
lines.zh: : 哇。这事儿是真的怎么都赢不了。

lines.en: : Whatever the case, just...
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，只是……

lines.en: : Try and make sure she has a good life in school, okay?
lines.zh: : 尽量确保她在学校里过得好，好吗？

lines.en: : Despite how much I want to, I can’t watch her every hour of every day.
lines.zh: : 我再想，也不可能一天二十四小时盯着她。

lines.en: : And...
lines.zh: : 还有……

lines.en: : Well, let’s just say there aren’t a lot of people who could have survived what I went through in high school.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这么说吧，能在我高中经历过的那些事里活下来的人，可不多。

lines.en: : That makes it sound like there was a little more pain than just a promiscuous teacher and abusive parents.
lines.zh: : 听你这口气，好像除了滥交的老师和虐待你的父母之外，还有更多的痛苦。

lines.en: : Of course there was.
lines.zh: : 当然有。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure I’m cursed.
lines.zh: : 我很确定我被诅咒了。

lines.en: : You really expect me to believe that?
lines.zh: : 你真指望我相信那个？

lines.en: : Not really.
lines.zh: : 不太指望。

lines.en: : But I wouldn’t expect anyone to believe it.
lines.zh: : 但我本来也不指望有人会信。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t expect anyone to believe or even {i}understand{/i} anything I went through back then.
lines.zh: : 我不指望有人相信、甚至{i}理解{/i}我当年经历过的任何事。

lines.en: : And if keeping Sana happy will prevent her from ever being forced to endure any of it-
lines.zh: : 而如果让 Sana 幸福，能让她永远不必被迫承受其中任何一件——

lines.en: : Well, I’d do anything.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我什么都愿意做。

lines.en: scene sarawindow22
: But, thankfully, she has a super great teacher who only {i}possibly{/i} wants to have sex with her! And I think that’s a good start!
lines.zh: : 不过，谢天谢地，她有个超级棒的老师，而且只是{i}「有可能」{/i}想跟她上床！我觉得这是个不错的开始！

lines.en: : Okay, so, remember how you were concerned a little while ago about what to do and {i}not{/i} do as a parent? I think this is “not do” territory.
lines.zh: : 好，那个，还记得你不久前还在担心作为父母该做什么{i}不该{/i}做什么吗？我觉得这块属于「不该做」的范畴。

lines.en: : Hey, I’m not the one doing anything. I’m just saying that us Sakakibara girls have both extremely high sex drives {i}and{/i} a thing for teachers. Do with that information what you will.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我可什么都没做。我只是说，我们 Sakakibara 家的女人性欲都极强，而且{i}还{/i}都对老师有想法。这信息你爱怎么用怎么用。

lines.en: : Stop assuming the level of your daughter’s sex drive if you don’t want to negatively affect the way I think of her.
lines.zh: : 如果你不想让我对她的看法变负面，就别去臆测你女儿性欲的强弱。

lines.en: : Negatively? I think my sex drive is one of my best qualities. Are you telling me that I should maybe consider {i}not{/i} wanting to have sex all the time?
lines.zh: : 负面？我觉得我的性欲是我最好的优点之一。你是在告诉我，我或许该考虑一下{i}别{/i}随时随地都想做爱吗？

lines.en: if sarasex == True:
: No. You stay exactly the way you are.
lines.zh: : 不。你就保持现在这个样子。

lines.en: : Awwwww~ That’s a really cute thing to say for someone who doesn’t want to marry me yet.
lines.zh: : 呜哇哇哇~ 对一个还不想娶我的人来说，这话可真甜。

lines.en: : “Yet” kind of implies that I might eventually change my mind.
lines.zh: : 「还」这个字，暗示着我最终可能会改变主意。

lines.en: : You will.
lines.zh: : 你会的。

lines.en: : An angel told me.
lines.zh: : 一个天使告诉我的。

lines.en: : Sure thing, Sara.
lines.zh: : 你说得对，Sara。

lines.en: : Sure thing.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。

lines.en: scene black
I fight away the urge to take Sara back to her bedroom as I remember what she said a little earlier about not wanting to go down that path tonight.
lines.zh: 我压下了把 Sara 带回卧室的冲动，想起她先前说过今晚不想走那条路。

lines.en: And while it’s a minor inconvenience to me, I can’t blame her for the desire to feel wanted in a way that doesn’t end up with semen oozing out of her for once.
lines.zh: 虽然这对我有点小小的不便，但我没法怪她——她想被人在乎，想用一种不用以精液从她身体里渗出来收场的方式被在乎，哪怕只有一次。

lines.en: Especially since it’s clear now that that’s all she’s ever wanted.
lines.zh: 尤其是现在很清楚，那一直是她唯一想要的东西。

lines.en: Not the semen part- but the part where she can look out at the city like this and think to herself, even if only briefly, “This is nice.”
lines.zh: 不是精液那部分——而是她能像这样望着这座城市，在心里对自己说，哪怕只有一瞬，「这样真好」。

lines.en: And it is. That much, I will concede.
lines.zh: 而这样确实很好。这一点我承认。

lines.en: But, just as all things must, our time together comes to an end.
lines.zh: 但就像万事万物一样，我们共度的时光也走到了尽头。

lines.en: On the way down the creaky staircase of the bar, the one that I’d still be able to make my way up even if it were destroyed, I have a thought-
lines.zh: 走下酒吧那嘎吱作响的楼梯时——那楼梯就算塌了我也能摸着走上去——我突然冒出一个念头——

lines.en: How happy would Sara be if I elected to stay the night?
lines.zh: 如果我选择留下来过夜，Sara 会有多开心？

lines.en: Not as a sexual partner, but as someone who genuinely wants to be near her. And hear more about the atrocities that plagued her when she was younger- still not relenting all this time later.
lines.zh: 不是作为性伴侣，而是作为一个真心想待在她身边的人。听她多讲讲她小时候缠绕着她的那些惨事——直到这么久以后的今天都没放过她。

lines.en: I’m sure she’d love that.
lines.zh: 我肯定她会喜欢。

lines.en: But, just as I’m about to turn around and turn that hypothetical scenario into reality-
lines.zh: 可就在我准备转身、把这个假设变成现实的时候——

lines.en: One of her stairs cracks.
lines.zh: 她家的一级楼梯裂了。

lines.en: And I no longer feel comfortable enough to go back up.
lines.zh: 于是我再也不太想回去了。

lines.en: $ sara_love += 2
{i}Sara’s affection has increased to [sara_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Sara 的好感度提升到了 [sara_love]!{/i}

lines.en: scene sarawindow23
I wind up somewhere vaguely familiar on the way home.
lines.zh: 回家的路上，我绕到了一个隐约熟悉的地方。

lines.en: I know I’ve been here before, but I can’t remember when.
lines.zh: 我知道我来过这里，但记不清是什么时候。

lines.en: And, unfortunately, I can’t quite remember how to get back or...when I even started heading here instead of just taking the normal path home.
lines.zh: 而且不幸的是，我不太记得该怎么回去，也不记得……我到底是什么时候开始往这儿走，而不是直接走平常那条回家的路的。

lines.en: Thankfully, my phone still has a little battery left and-
lines.zh: 幸好我的手机还有点电，而且——

lines.en: : Are you lost?
lines.zh: : 你迷路了吗？

lines.en: scene black
{i}The happiest day -- the happiest hour{/i}
lines.zh: {i}最幸福的那一天——最幸福的那一刻{/i}

lines.en: {i}My sear'd and blighted heart hath known,{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我这颗枯焦凋敝的心所曾识得，{/i}

lines.en: {i}The highest hope of pride and power,{/i}
lines.zh: {i}那关于骄傲与权势的至高希冀，{/i}

lines.en: {i}I feel hath flown.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我感到，已然飞逝。{/i}

lines.en: {i}For on its wing was dark alloy,{/i}
lines.zh: {i}因为在它的翅膀上带着晦暗的杂质，{/i}

lines.en: {i}And, as it flutter'd -- fell{/i}
lines.zh: {i}而当它振翅——坠落{/i}

lines.en: {i}An essence -- powerful to destroy{/i}
lines.zh: {i}一缕精粹——足以摧毁{/i}

lines.en: {i}A soul that knew it well.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}一颗对它了如指掌的灵魂。{/i}

lines.en: scene sarawindow24
: Who are you?...
lines.zh: : 你是谁？……

lines.en: : A girl, obviously.
lines.zh: : 一个女孩，显然。

lines.en: : Have you ever seen one before?
lines.zh: : 你以前没见过吗？

lines.en: : I see many of them every day.
lines.zh: : 我每天都见到很多。

lines.en: : Oooooh, a sarcastic type, are you?
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，是个爱讽刺的类型，是吧？

lines.en: : And here I was ready to give you directions.
lines.zh: : 我本来还准备给你指路呢。

lines.en: : I’ll be fine. I can just use the GPS app on my phone.
lines.zh: : 我没事。我可以用手机上的 GPS 应用。

lines.en: : Hmmmm...
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯嗯……

lines.en: : Are you sure about that?
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, I-
lines.zh: : 当然，我——

lines.en: : Wait, when did it die? My battery was fine like a second ago.
lines.zh: : 等等，什么时候关机的？我的电池一秒钟前还好好的。

lines.en: I try pressing the power button on my phone to see if I’d just accidentally turned it off or something, but there's no luck.
lines.zh: 我试着按了按手机的电源键，想看看是不是不小心把它关掉了什么的，但没用。

lines.en: : Funny how things work out sometimes, huh?
lines.zh: : 有时候事情就是这么巧，对吧？

lines.en: : And when you least expect it, too.
lines.zh: : 而且还偏偏在你最想不到的时候。

lines.en: : How did you know my phone was dead?
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道我手机没电了？

lines.en: : Hmmm...
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯……

lines.en: : A guess?
lines.zh: : 猜的？

lines.en: : I’m not sure if I believe that.
lines.zh: : 我不确定我信不信。

lines.en: : You can believe whatever it is you want to believe.
lines.zh: : 你爱信什么就信什么。

lines.en: : That’s the best part of being alive. Isn’t it, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那就是活着最好的地方。不是吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : ...How do you know my name?
lines.zh: : ……你怎么知道我的名字？

lines.en: : Your name is Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你的名字是 Sensei？

lines.en: : I just thought you looked like a teacher.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得你看起来像个老师。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize you could “look” like a teacher.
lines.zh: : 我不知道「看起来」还能像个老师。

lines.en: : It’s the glasses.
lines.zh: : 是因为眼镜。

lines.en: : So, do you want me to tell you the way back or not?
lines.zh: : 那么，你到底要不要告诉我回去的路？

lines.en: : How do you even know where “back” is?
lines.zh: : 你怎么会知道「回去」是哪儿？

lines.en: : You’re sure asking a lot of questions for some random guy alone in the middle of nowhere.
lines.zh: : 一个孤零零站在荒郊野外的陌生男人，问题还真多。

lines.en: : And you’re sure acting suspicious for a teenage girl alone in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: : 而一个深夜独自在外的少女，举止也真够可疑的。

lines.en: : I think I'm acting completely normal, thank you very much.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我表现得完全正常，非常感谢。

lines.en: : You're the weird one.
lines.zh: : 奇怪的是你。

lines.en: : Then...since we’ve finally gotten our introductions out of the way, can you tell me how to get back now?
lines.zh: : 那么……既然我们好歹算互相介绍过了，你能告诉我现在怎么回去吗？

lines.en: : Sure.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : But you’re going to owe me a drink if we ever bump into each other again, got it?
lines.zh: : 但如果我们再碰上，你得欠我一杯酒，明白吗？

lines.en: : Whatever you say.
lines.zh: : 随你说。

lines.en: : So, where do I go?
lines.zh: : 那么，我该往哪儿走？

lines.en: : First step-
lines.zh: : 第一步——

lines.en: : Close your eyes.
lines.zh: : 闭上眼睛。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Just listen to me. I know what I’m talking about.
lines.zh: : 听我的就是了。我知道我在说什么。

lines.en: scene black
: Fine. Whatever. I’ll play along.
lines.zh: : 好吧。随便。我配合就是了。

lines.en: : Great! Now, spin around three times and say “Olly olly oxen free!”
lines.zh: : 很好！现在，原地转三圈，然后喊「藏好了的都出来吧！」

lines.en: : Oh, then jump as high as you can. Like, really, really high.
lines.zh: : 哦，然后尽可能往高跳。就是，非常、非常地高。

lines.en: scene bedroom_night
: Listen, if you’re just going to-
lines.zh: : 听着，如果你只是想——

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: I look down to find my phone in my hands once again.
lines.zh: 我低头一看，手机又回到了我手里。

lines.en: The battery isn’t dead anymore.
lines.zh: 电池不再是没电的状态了。

lines.en: What just happened?...
lines.zh: 刚刚发生了什么？……

lines.en: scene black
I take a moment to collect my thoughts, but I’m unable to find them all.
lines.zh: 我花了一点时间整理思绪，却怎么也找不全。

lines.en: Then, not knowing what else to do this late at night, I make the executive decision to rule my strange meeting with that girl as just yet another blackout.
lines.zh: 然后，这么晚了也不知道还能做什么，我擅自决定，把和那个女孩的这场诡异相遇，当作又一次断片。

lines.en: Just...
lines.zh: 只是……

lines.en: It felt so much different than all of the others.
lines.zh: 这次的感觉，和之前所有的都不一样。

else:
: With me? Yeah. I think I’ve made that pretty clear.
lines.zh: : 跟我？是啊。我觉得我已经说得很明白了。

lines.en: : Hey, you don’t have control over my thoughts.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我的想法你可管不着。

lines.en: : I’m allowed to {i}want{/i} to have sex with you all the time. I’m just not allowed to actually do it.
lines.zh: : 我可以随时随地{i}想{/i}跟你做爱。我只是不被允许真的去做。

lines.en: : What a convenient loophole.
lines.zh: : 好一个方便的漏洞。

lines.en: : {i}Speaking{/i} of convenient holes...
lines.zh: : {i}说到{/i}方便的洞……

lines.en: : You’ve been spending too much time with Maki.
lines.zh: : 你跟 Maki 待太久了。

lines.en: scene black
I don’t stay much longer.
lines.zh: 我没再待多久。

lines.en: As I head for the door, I hear Sara mention something along the lines of not thinking she’ll be able to fall asleep tonight.
lines.zh: 我走向门口时，听到 Sara 说了句类似今晚大概睡不着之类的话。

lines.en: I don’t ask why, as I’d like to leave it open ended.
lines.zh: 我没问为什么，我想把这件事留个开放式结局。

lines.en: If I heard the real answer, it might spoil my walk home.
lines.zh: 要是听到了真正的答案，可能会毁了我回家的这段路。

lines.en: So, in blissful ignorance of the horrible things I’m sure she’ll feel, I’ll force myself to pretend that the reason for her insomnia is me.
lines.zh: 所以，我就幸福地无视掉那些我确定她会感受到的可怕的东西，硬逼自己假装她失眠的原因是我。

lines.en: And that all of the darkness fermenting within in her will be replaced by the illusion of my seed- filling her insides with not only warmth-
lines.zh: 而她体内发酵的所有黑暗，都会被我的种子的幻象所取代——不只是用温暖填满她的身体——

lines.en: But her neverending desire to know what it means to be loved.
lines.zh: 还有她那永无止境的、想知道被爱是什么滋味的需求。

lines.en: But that, just like everything else-
lines.zh: 但那，就像其他一切一样——

lines.en: Is an illusion.
lines.zh: 是幻象。
